jobs.title: Say a skill was taught
steps: Find the skill. On a row not taught yet, press [[Say it is taught]] and choose the class.
It is taught for that class alone. No other class changes.

jobs.title: Change a level
steps: To change a level's words, open the skill and press [[Change this level's sentence]].
Change the words and press [[Save the words]]. That level then waits for approval again.
Changing the description or the short name sends every level back for approval.
The rule each question is checked against stays as it is. Questions are not edited here.
To move a level to another grade, use [[Which grade each level belongs to]] and press [[Save the grades]]. The skill keeps its approval.
To change one child's level on a class paper, see [Papers to approve](/guide/papers-to-approve#change-level).

jobs.title: See which levels may be too easy
steps: Open [Levels to review](/skill-sets/levels). No menu item opens it yet.
Each suggestion says how many children were counted. Press [[I've looked at this]] when you have read it.
It only suggests. How it counts is on [How it is worked out](/guide/worked-out#levels-to-review).

buttons.label: Say it is taught
buttons.does: Records the skill or topic as taught for one class, in your name. Its skills can then go on that class's papers.

buttons.label: Save the words
buttons.does: Saves new words for the skill. They wait for approval before they are the skill's words.
buttons.doesNot: The rule questions are checked against is kept exactly as it was.

buttons.label: Save the grades
buttons.does: Moves a level to another grade.
buttons.doesNot: The level's words do not change, so the skill keeps its approval.

buttons.label: I've looked at this
buttons.does: Hides a suggestion until its counts move.
